name: Livermore Youth Council (LYC)
what_you_do: Speak up for Livermore youth to the City Council, the park district and the school district. Plan projects and events.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students. The city code says ages 12 to 20, best if at Livermore schools. You must come to meetings and events.
duration: One school year. Three absences count as quitting.
deadline_text: The application form is on the Youth Council page. No due date is shown.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Recruitment Application Form on the Youth Council page. Ask the city when it is due.
notes: The city code still calls it the Livermore Area Youth Advisory Commission.
